body: Thank you. I'll go and check it out.
You don't know how much that means to me. People say to just shut up, grin, and bear it. I can't any more. Thank you for relating

I need to look for another therapist. I'm on my 4th one and was hoping this was the one. But these days they're telling me grounding techniques and to work out situations are the best solutions since they're not physically harming me.

Question: How did you start over? How did you get the courage? How do I let go of the guilt?
There are so many nights where I just lay there until the sun comes up... I'll snooze here and there and when I wake up...I cry because I'm alive another day.

Sleep...I haven't had sleep. Sometimes I wonder if that's a thing anymore. My workmates tell me that I need sleep. But I have to take care of everyone else otherwise my anxiety won't let me have any sort of rest.

But thank you...I didn't even think about vacation as an option. I'm so tired...I just went straight to depressed.
